messages:
Alex: Quick idea — can we pilot a lightweight followthrough 'radar' for postmortem actions? Keep it 3 checkpoints (48h, 7d, 21d) and one recurring monthly digest.
Mina: +1. The 48h should be for critical blockers only, 7d for owners to update, 21d for closure or mitigation tracking.
Sam: How do you want to track owners? Jira tasks or GH issues?
Alex: Prefer Jira for now (we already have SLAs tied). Proposal: create a remediation ticket with label `remediation/pm-followup` and a custom field `followup-due` for the 3 checkpoints.
Jess: Can we avoid extra manual steps? Maybe a slash command to bootstrap the ticket: `/remediate create <incident-id>` that auto-populates labels and due dates.
Mina: OpsBot could create the ticket when the PM posts the postmortem final draft. OpsBot: I can implement a webhook to create Jira issues with a template. Need a JIRA project key.
Alex: Use project key INF for infra, PROD for product incidents. Default to INF if none.
Sam: For comms cadence: root postmortem thread gets a pinned checkbox with links to the Jira ticket and the 3 checkpoint comments. We should @channel only for 48h if unresolved.
Jess: Also define roles per incident: Owner (creates/updates ticket), Reviewer (validates remediation), POC (keeps stakeholders updated). Should be fields on the Jira ticket.
Leo: What about recurring patterns detection? If we see the same `failure-mode` label on 3 incidents in 30 days, auto-escalate to a pattern review board.
Mina: Love that. OpsBot: could post a weekly summary to #incidents with top repeated labels.
OpsBot: I will post a weekly digest on Mondays at 10:00 with label counts and links. Will also send DM reminders to owners 2 days before each checkpoint due date.
Alex: For IC rotation: propose a rolling roster in the ops handbook. IC for a week, handoff doc template for next IC. Rotation cadence: 1 week during business hours, 2 weeks for on-call.
Sam: Let's run a trial next month on a small set of incidents — 4 incidents across infra and product. Track time-to-update and closure rate.
Jess: Metrics to collect: % of remediations with owner assigned within 24h, % closed by 21d, avg time between detection and triage ticket creation.
Mina: Would be helpful to add a tiny 'close reason' dropdown in Jira: fixed, mitigated, won't-fix, duplicate, other.
Alex: Agree. Also require a short learning note in the ticket before closure.
Sam: Who volunteers to scope OpsBot changes? I can take the webhook + DM reminders. Mina can do the Jira templates.
Mina: Yep, I'll draft the templates and field list. Jess can update the ops handbook with the IC rotation and comms cadence.
Jess: On it. I'll post a PR to the handbook and ping you all for review.
Alex: Thanks — action owners: Sam (OpsBot webhook & reminders), Mina (Jira templates + labels), Jess (handbook + rotation), Leo (pattern detection logic spec). I'll create the followthrough radar ticket now.
OpsBot: /incident followthrough created INF-1234 by Alex. Reminder schedule: 48h, 7d, 21d. Weekly digest added to #incidents.
